# Tier `maxwell-3`

## Serving

| setting | value | what it controls |
|---|---|---|
| backend | `cuda` | which `llama-swap.*.yaml` template renders |
| ctx_size | 32768 | the served window (`--ctx-size`) |
| kv_type | `f16` | `--cache-type-k/v`, kept symmetric |
| flash_attn | `on` | `--flash-attn` (required for a q8_0 V cache) |
| resident_tier | `gemma4-e2b` | the model that stays hot; seeds the agent planner seat (agent_model) when it differs from the workhorse |
| agent_ctx_tokens | 32768 | the agent's `-ctx-tokens` compaction budget |
| 26B-A4B | dropped | whether the 26B MoE is served, and where its experts live |

## Agent seat

This tier declares no persistent vLLM agent seat: the agent lane runs on the
llama.cpp seat named by `agent_model` above, in the tier's own llama-swap config.

## Media

This tier serves these media **seats** — models in its own llama-swap config, rendered
at install time. Each seat also produces the harness config binding that routes to it, so a
binding can never name a seat that was not rendered:

| seat | kind | binds | model | residency |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `gemma4-e2b-vision` | vision | `vision_model` | `gemma-4-E2B-it-qat-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf` | swappable |
| `whisper-stt` | stt | `stt_model` | `ggml-large-v3-turbo-q5_0.bin` | swappable |

A seat still needs its weights on the box — model downloads stay out-of-band, as with
every seed.

The installer seeds this tier's media bindings (`config_seed`):

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `animategen_script` | `` |
| `compose_script` | `render/compose-hyperframes.mjs` |
| `musicgen_script` | `` |
| `run_graph_script` | `` |
| `videogen_script` | `` |
| `voicegen_script` | `` |

`__OFFLOAD_HOME__` is replaced with the install root at render time.

## Installer-seeded config (non-media)

These `config_seed` keys are applied to a FRESH harness config exactly like the media
seed, but they bind no media route — the agent/cascade seats and per-node knobs live
here so they are never mistaken for a media capability:

| key | value |
|---|---|
| `agent_profile` | `research` |
| `escalation_model` | `` |
| `fleet_max_concurrent_jobs` | `1` |
| `model` | `gemma4-e2b` |
| `reasoning_model` | `` |

## Operator notes

Recorded with the profile — several are measurements from real hardware,
including reasons a tempting change was deliberately not made.

> Config #18: the 3 GB band (sm_52 Maxwell, GTX 970M-class). Reference box <node-g>, the 2015 gaming laptop: GTX 970M 3 GB GDDR5, a 4-core/8-thread Skylake mobile CPU, 32 GB DDR4. Spec: docs/specs/2026-10-28-maxwell-3-tier-design.md. Every value below marked PROJECTED is replaced by its measurement on that box before this tier is called measured; the MEASURED figures are from the 2026-10-28 smoke. ENGINE (MEASURED 2026-10-28): the pinned llama.cpp b11490 win-cuda-12.4 prebuilt runs on sm_52 through its embedded sm_50 PTX - a one-time JIT of ~36 s cached under CUDA_CACHE_PATH (the install sets CUDA_CACHE_MAXSIZE so the cache is never evicted); CUDA graphs are disabled below Volta by the backend itself (disable_cuda_graphs true is documentary), there is no fp16 math and no MMQ, so prefill is dequant-to-F32 + cuBLAS, and flash-attn runs through the f32 vec/tile kernels - MEASURED FASTER on this card, so it stays on. E2B UD-Q4_K_XL llama-bench: pp512 374 t/s, tg128 39.2 t/s (43.1 t/s with flash-attn on); llama-server fits 8K/16K/32K with q8_0 KV at 1434/1468/1535 MiB and 16K f16 flash-attn-on at 1517 MiB (40.7 t/s); 1037 MHz, 56-60 C, 22-28 W. RESIDENT TIER E2B, E4B OMITTED (omit_e4b): the E4B needs 3,100 MiB at 16K (measured on <node-c>), more than the 3,072 MiB card holds beside the resident embedder and the WDDM reserve, so the workhorse here is the E2B, config_seed.model names it, and the 6 GB band's E4B entry and download are dropped rather than rendered into an OOM. CTX 32K, f16 KV: the Gemma-4 E-series KV barely grows (512-token sliding window), f16 costs tens of MiB over q8_0 at 32K, and q8_0's dequant has no fp16 path on this card. 26B DROPPED: no placement fits a 3 GB card. AGENT SEAT: none bound yet (PROJECTED): the agent lane falls back to the workhorse E2B (config_seed.model) until the bake on <node-g> (the 2026-08-17 ampere-6 instrument, shapes B and C, fabrication disqualifies, bar 0.5) picks the best candidate that fits beside the resident embedder in the ~2.4 GiB swappable budget: Qwen3.5-4B UD-IQ3_XXS, Qwen3.5-2B UD-Q4_K_XL, MiniCPM5-2B Q4_K_M, LFM3-1.7B (needs llama.cpp b11938 or later; a win there bumps the global pin to b11946, which keeps the sm_50 PTX). The winner gets its own single-slot entry (explicit --parallel 1) and agent_model binds to it. MEDIA SEATS (MEASURED 2026-10-28, one real call each on the card, details in each seat's `measured`): vision gemma4-e2b-vision = the resident E2B weights + the ggml-org Q8_0 projector at ctx 8192 with reasoning off, 2,578 MiB loaded / 2,819 MiB peak beside the embedder, a website screenshot described and a receipt extracted correctly in Spanish; stt whisper-stt = large-v3-turbo q5_0 + silero v5.1.2 with flash attention OFF (-nfa), 977 / 1,037 MiB, a 759 KB Spanish clip in 10.4 s (flash attention on was slower at 14.5 s for 150 MiB less). Both are SWAPPABLE: either one beside the 2,009 MiB chat seat overflows the card, so a media call evicts the chat seat and the next chat call reloads it in ~3 s. Their weights are pin-only in install.ps1 (model-e2b-mmproj, model-whisper-turbo-q5, model-silero-v5): placed by the operator, warned about by `install render` when absent. IMAGE: sd.cpp Vulkan with sdxl-turbo Q4_0 is bound only after smoke 4 renders a correct image on this card (pending at this writing). RAM SPILL (ADR 0080): the Qwen3.6-35B-A3B spill seat is not carried on this band until its three gates (adds capability, no RAM hog, stable) are measured here; fleet_max_concurrent_jobs stays 1 (one slot). NOT a Blackwell-style CUDA-13 box: the cuda-13 prebuilts carry no Maxwell code, so Select-CudaBuild keeps the 12.4 prebuilt for this profile.
